bug_locations: rolling_mean: missing validation of min_periods (spec requires 1 <= min_periods <= window)
rolling_mean: return expression ignored min_periods; positions whose trailing window contains fewer than min_periods values must produce null (None) instead of a mean
explanation: The original function accepted min_periods but never used it. Two defects resulted: (1) no validation that 1 <= min_periods <= window, so invalid values were silently accepted; (2) every position always received a mean computed over however many values happened to be in the trailing window, even when fewer than min_periods values were present. The fix adds ValueError checks for min_periods < 1 and min_periods > window (keeping the existing window <= 0 check), and emits None for any position whose trailing window xs[max(0, i-window+1):i+1] contains fewer than min_periods elements, otherwise the mean. With the default min_periods=1 the visible check still passes since every position has at least one value.
